info.title: Meilisearch Cloud API V2
info.description:
Manages Meilisearch Cloud organizations, teams and projects. Request and response fields are camelCase.

## Authentication

Send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` with a Personal Access Token or an OAuth2 access token. OAuth2 tokens need the `read` scope for GET requests and `write` for every other method. See [Authentication](https://www.meilisearch.com/docs/reference/management-api/authentication).

## Pagination

List endpoints take `offset` and `limit` and return `{ results, offset, limit, total }`.

## Errors

Every non-2xx response has the `Error` body. Read its `code` field to know the exact error. Each operation documents the statuses it can answer. Every endpoint can also answer:

- `400` `invalid_id`: an id in the path or the query is not an integer.
- `400` `invalid_body`: the body is not valid JSON.
- `400` `unknown_field`: the body has a field the endpoint does not accept.
- `400` `invalid_offset`, `invalid_limit`: invalid pagination parameter on a list endpoint.
- `401` `missing_authorization_header`, `invalid_token`: no token, or an invalid, expired or revoked one.
- `403` `forbidden`: the OAuth2 token does not have the scope the method needs.
- `429` `rate_limited`: over 30 requests per minute per token. Retry after the number of seconds in the `Retry-After` header.
- `500` `internal`: unexpected error.

get.description: Lists the projects of the teams the authenticated user can access. Terminated projects are only returned with `includeTerminated`.

x-codeSamples.label: HTTP request
x-codeSamples.source:
curl \
  -X POST 'https://api.meilisearch.com/api/v2/teams' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer MANAGEMENT_API_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data-binary '{
    "name": "Search team",
    "organizationId": 1
  }'

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Id of the team.

get.description: Returns a team the authenticated user can access.

patch.description: Renames a team or transfers its ownership to one of its members. Only the team owner or the organization owner can update it.

value.message: The request body is not valid JSON.
You are not allowed to perform this action.
The user must already be a member of the team.

details.message: The user must already be a member of the team.

ownerId.description: `id` of the new owner, as returned by the members list. Must already be a member of the team.

delete.description: Deletes a team that has no active project. Only the team owner or the organization owner can delete it.

value.message: You are not allowed to perform this action.
The team still has active projects.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Maximum number of items to return. Values above the maximum are capped to it.

personal_access_token.description: Send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, where `<token>` is a personal access token (PAT) or an OAuth2 access token. A PAT authenticates as the user who owns it. See [Authentication](https://www.meilisearch.com/docs/reference/management-api/authentication).

oauth2.description: OAuth2 authorization code flow with PKCE, for partner applications acting on behalf of a user. Send the user to the authorization URL in their browser. `read` allows GET requests, `write` allows every other method. See [Authentication](https://www.meilisearch.com/docs/reference/management-api/authentication).

Error.description: Error body returned by every non-2xx response. Switch on `code`, never on `message`.

code.description: Stable snake_case identifier of the error.

type.description: Category of the error, derived from the HTTP status.

details.description: Request fields the error is about. Present whenever the error involves request fields.

field.description: Name of the field, in camelCase.

code.description: Reason the field was rejected, e.g. `missing` or `unknown`.

Pagination.description: Envelope of every list response, the items being in `results`.

total.description: Number of items matching the request.

identifier.description: Unique slug of the organization, derived from its name.

ownerId.description: `id` of the user who owns the organization.

isAdmin.description: Whether the authenticated user owns the organization.

organizationId.description: Id of the organization of the team.

ownerId.description: `id` of the user who owns the team.

isAdmin.description: Whether the authenticated user owns the team or its organization, and can manage it.

id.description: Identifies the member or the pending invitation, e.g. to remove it.

name.description: Name of the member. `null` for an invitation.

isOwner.description: Whether the member owns the team.

status.description: `accepted` for a member, `invited` for a pending invitation.

invitedAt.description: Date of the invitation. `null` for an accepted member.

PlanFeature.description: A billed feature of a plan, with its price.

stripePriceId.description: Id of the Stripe price of the feature.

unitPrice.description: Price of one unit, in USD.

monthlyEstimation.description: Estimated monthly price, in USD, for the base fee and the instance runtime.

transformQuantity.description: Billed per package of units: the quantity is divided by `divideBy` before applying `unitPrice`.

divideBy.description: Number of units in a package.

round.description: How the number of packages is rounded.

Resource.description: A machine size in a region, and the plan it belongs to.

displayName.description: Name shown in the Cloud UI.

regionId.description: Id of the region of the resource.

vcpu.description: Number of vCPUs of the machine.

fullPlan.description: Plan and pricing of the resource. `null` when the resource has no public plan.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country of the region.

greenLabel.description: Whether the region runs on low-carbon energy.

regionUrl.description: Domain of the project URLs in this region.

latest.description: Whether it is the latest version, used by default.

projectUid.description: Unique identifier of the project, used in its URL.

url.description: URL of the Meilisearch instance. `null` until its DNS record is ready.

masterKey.description: Only returned on project creation and master key endpoints.

teamId.description: Id of the team of the project.

resourceId.description: Id of the resource of the project.

readOnly.description: Whether the instance only accepts read requests.

terminatedAt.description: Termination date of the project. `null` for an active project.

freeTrialEndsAt.description: End date of the free trial. `null` outside a free trial.

ProjectUsageDay.description: Usage of a UTC day. A null quantity means nothing was collected that day.

runtime.description: Hours per machine size (resource), each one having its own hourly price.

hours.description: Hours the instance ran on this resource.

from.description: First UTC day of the window.

to.description: Last UTC day of the window.

days.description: Usage of each day of the window.

ProjectCostItem.description: A feature the project is billed per usage for. Monthly prices (storage, documents, base fee) are prorated on the hours the project existed.

resourceId.description: Machine size of an instance_runtime item.

from.description: First UTC day of the window.

to.description: Last UTC day of the window.

currency.description: Currency of the prices and amounts.
